The '''Power Generation Center''' was a generator complex in the [[High Security Section]] on the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. After the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] attacked Belsavis, they occupied the ruins of the Power Generation Center as they battled the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] for control of the region.
